theorem source_both_and_prime_rich
    (platform : WorldIO.Platform) (initial : Stream)
    (h : PrimaryInputs (3681/10000) (3599/10000))
    (hCHJ : OriginalCHJSource) (hrvm : ZeroCount.v1.rvm_error_bound)
    (hsmall : ZeroCount.v1.rvm_error_small)
    (hlow : LowZeroes.v1.no_zeroes_below_first_ordinate)
    (hRH : RiemannHypothesisUpTo WinnerOriginalScalars.height)
    (hQRH : ZetaZeroFreeHalfPlane (7/8)) :
    ∃ pairedTrace pairedFinal pairedOut massTrace massFinal,
      PairedScenario platform initial pairedTrace pairedFinal pairedOut ∧
      FinalProgram.Scenario .mass platform initial massTrace massFinal ∧
      (∀ L : ℝ, 330 ≤ L →
        HasPowerLogBound Eπ (sourceMassCoefficient L) 0 (7/8) (_root_.Real.exp L) ∧
        HasPowerLogBound Eψ (sourceMassCoefficient L) 0 (7/8) (_root_.Real.exp L)) ∧
      (HasPowerLogBound Eπ (7984699/1000000000) 0 (7/8) (_root_.Real.exp 400) ∧
        HasPowerLogBound Eψ (7984699/1000000000) 0 (7/8) (_root_.Real.exp 400)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, _root_.Real.exp 400 ≤ x →
        (1449/50000000:ℝ)*x^((7:ℝ)/8)/_root_.Real.log x ≤
        primeCounting (x+(2/125:ℝ)*x^((7:ℝ)/8))-primeCounting x) ∧
      (∀ L : ℝ, 330 < L → sourceMassCoefficient L <
        rationalHeightCoefficient (8433850764/1000000000000) L)

error_terms.Epi: abs(primeCounting x - Li x) / (x / log x)
error_terms.Li: offset logarithmic integral as defined in IEANTN vocabulary

bound_definition: For every x >= exp(A), E(x) <= c * log(x)^0 * x^(7/8 - 1), hence c*x^(-1/8).
program_scenario_qualification: The complete source theorems construct normal-I/O scenarios with source calls and read events. They do not assume all physical host executions have successful I/O.
